name: Bismuth telluride
equilibrium_context: Three-dimensional topological insulator, p-doped, bulk gap about 0.15 eV

driven_states.emergent_property: Time-resolved buildup of the Floquet-Bloch bands within a single optical cycle of the drive. Several sidebands emerge sequentially, intraband acceleration proceeds simultaneously in several sidebands, followed by destruction through scattering of high-energy electrons into bulk states.
driven_states.caveat: Only one group. The assignment of the subcycle dynamics relies heavily on non-equilibrium quantum calculations; the energy resolution is coarse at 100 meV. No independent gap measurement. The separation of intraband acceleration from genuine sideband formation is theory-supported, not model-free. Volkov states are excluded via s polarization plus in-situ field reconstruction by momentum streaking - methodologically strong.

threshold.quantity: none - Floquet dressing has no threshold

driven_states.measured_quantity: subcycle-resolved photoemission, field waveform from streaking

provenance.notes: Literature search and field extraction by AI agents under the direction of D. Leonforte (independent researcher); every numerical value and citation checked against the cited work and every DOI verified. Not reviewed by a domain expert. Corrections are welcome and are the intended path to improvement.
